About Neurodivergent Nest

Neurodivergent Nest exists because most productivity, organisation, and self-help content was built for neurotypical brains — and we're done pretending it works.

We're a team of ADHD and neurodivergent adults who got fed up with advice like "just make a to-do list" and "set a timer." Advice that never asks why starting is so hard, why the list never gets touched, why the timer turns into a spiral of guilt.

What we actually do

Every article, resource recommendation, and strategy on this site is developed with neurodivergent brains in mind — built around executive function research, sensory processing, dopamine systems, and the real challenges of adult ADHD life.

We cover: organisation, productivity, money management, work and career, relationships, parenting with ADHD, and the emotional side of living with a brain that society hasn't quite figured out how to accommodate yet.

Our editorial standards

  • Science-backed — We reference peer-reviewed research and clinical guidelines, not just personal anecdotes.
  • Zero judgment — There is no "should" here. Only what works and what doesn't.
  • Transparent about money — Some links are affiliate links. We disclose every single one. We never recommend something we don't believe in.
  • Written by neurodivergent people — Not by marketing teams or AI bots. By people who live this.

Get in touch

We'd love to hear from you — what topics you want covered, what's working, what isn't. Email us at hello@neurodivergent-nest.vercel.app.
